name: app-health-tiles-with-serif-insight-on-tilted-phone-corner
title: Cropped phone corner with glass health tiles and a serif insight card on a blue-peach gradient
whatItIs: A tightly cropped lavender phone corner on a peach-to-periwinkle gradient. The screen shows three glass tiles with dotted sparklines (VO2 Max, RHR, HRV), an insight card in serif 'Your HRV is down 15% this week. Try a recovery day.' with a black arrow, and a floating tab bar.
whatItMeans: Calm and editorial; the serif sentence turns data into advice.
techniques: Crop the device tightly to enlarge the UI.
Set numbers in italic serif on glass tiles.
Write the insight as a sentence.
Float the tab bar as a glass pill.

vocabulary.definition: Framing only a corner of a device.
Numbers set in an italic serif face.
